description: Swap one layer of a layer-built design without changing the rest: likeness + photo_id (an accepted photo from bamf.list_likeness_photos; a pending AI photo is used but flagged), likeness + new_candid (requests new candid photos, pending), art (new art for the art layer only), or text + slots (rerender, no model call).

new_candid.description: Describe the candid photo to request.

name: bamf.replace_design_layer
